description: This file provides helper functions for managing properties in a software system, including querying, setting, and typecasting property values. It interacts with an IPC-based property service and includes functions for retrieving properties as various data types, as well as validating and modifying properties.

methods.name: bool hasProperty(const char * propName)
methods.description: Checks if a property with the given name is set in the property service.

methods.name: bool canServerSetProperty(const char * propName,const char * propsValue)
methods.description: Determines if a remote request can set the specified property and value, with special checks for SSL verification properties.

methods.name: char * getPropertyAsString(const char * propName,const char * defValue)
methods.description: Retrieves a property value as a string from the property service; returns a default if unavailable.

methods.name: const char * getPropertyEventAsString(const cpePropertyEvent * event,const char * defValue)
methods.description: Returns the property value from an event or a default if the event is invalid or deleted.

methods.name: int32_t getInternalAsInt32(const char * value,int32_t defValue)
methods.description: Converts a string to a 32-bit integer, using a default if conversion is invalid.

methods.name: int32_t getPropertyAsInt32(const char * propName,int32_t defValue)
methods.description: Retrieves a property as a 32-bit integer, returning a default if necessary.

methods.name: int32_t getPropertyEventAsInt32(const cpePropertyEvent * event,int32_t defValue)
methods.description: Extracts an int32 property value from an event or returns a default.

methods.name: uint32_t getInternalAsUInt32(const char * value,uint32_t defValue)
methods.description: Converts a string to an unsigned 32-bit integer with default fallback.

methods.name: uint32_t getPropertyAsUInt32(const char * propName,uint32_t defValue)
methods.description: Retrieves a property as an unsigned 32-bit integer.

methods.name: uint32_t getPropertyEventAsUInt32(const cpePropertyEvent * event,uint32_t defValue)
methods.description: Gets an unsigned 32-bit integer property from an event.

methods.name: int64_t getInternalAsInt64(const char * value,int64_t defValue)
methods.description: Converts a string to a 64-bit integer with default fallback.

methods.name: int64_t getPropertyAsInt64(const char * propName,int64_t defValue)
methods.description: Retrieves a property as a 64-bit integer.

methods.name: int64_t getPropertyEventAsInt64(const cpePropertyEvent * event,int64_t defValue)
methods.description: Gets a 64-bit integer property from an event.

methods.name: uint64_t getInternalAsUInt64(const char * value,uint64_t defValue)
methods.description: Converts a string to a 64-bit unsigned integer, with fallback.

methods.name: uint64_t getPropertyAsUInt64(const char * propName,uint64_t defValue)
methods.description: Retrieves a property as a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: uint64_t getPropertyEventAsUInt64(const cpePropertyEvent * event,uint64_t defValue)
methods.description: Gets an unsigned 64-bit integer property from an event.

methods.name: bool getInternalAsBool(const char * value,bool defValue)
methods.description: Converts a string value to a boolean, with a default fallback.

methods.name: bool getPropertyAsBool(const char * propName,bool defValue)
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean property.

methods.name: bool getPropertyEventAsBool(const cpePropertyEvent * event,bool defValue)
methods.description: Gets a boolean property from an event.

methods.name: propSetResult setPropertyValue(const char * propName,const char * propValue,bool overwrite,propSource source)
methods.description: Sets a property value with optional overwrite, returning a result code.

methods.name: propSetResult setPropertyUInt32(const char * propName,uint32_t value,bool overwrite,propSource source)
methods.description: Sets a uint32 property value.

methods.name: propSetResult setPropertyInt32(const char * propName,int32_t value,bool overwrite,propSource source)
methods.description: Sets an int32 property value.

methods.name: propSetResult setPropertyUInt64(const char * propName,uint64_t value,bool overwrite,propSource source)
methods.description: Sets a uint64 property value.

methods.name: propSetResult setPropertyInt64(const char * propName,int64_t value,bool overwrite,propSource source)
methods.description: Sets an int64 property value.

methods.name: propSetResult setPropertyBool(const char * propName,bool value,bool overwrite,propSource source)
methods.description: Sets a boolean property value.

ctags.pattern: /^static int32_t getInternalAsInt32(const char* value, int32_t defValue)$/
